Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Employee medical records submitted for leave or administrative purposes contain sensitive personal data protected by privacy principles.

questions.question_english: During staff recruitment, asking a female candidate about her marital status or plans to have children is:
options_english: Necessary for planning substitute teaching schedules in advance
Discriminatory and irrelevant to competence
Standard administrative practice under civil service hiring rules
Acceptable for assessing candidate long-term organizational commitment
questions.explanation_english: Questioning female job candidates about marital plans or family planning during recruitment interviews constitutes gender discrimination and violates equal opportunity employment laws. Such questions are irrelevant to assessing professional competence, pedagogical skills, or job qualifications. Recruitment evaluations must remain focused strictly on objective, job-related criteria, ensuring fair, non-discriminatory selection processes for all applicants.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। महिला नौकरी उम्मीदवारों से वैवाहिक योजनाओं या परिवार नियोजन के बारे में पूछना भर्ती साक्षात्कार के दौरान लिंग भेदभाव का गठन करता है और समान अवसर रोजगार कानूनों का उल्लंघन करता है। ऐसे प्रश्न पेशेवर क्षमता, शैक्षणिक कौशल, या नौकरी की योग्यताओं का आकलन करने के लिए अप्रासंगिक हैं। भर्ती मूल्यांकन को केवल वस्तुनिष्ठ, नौकरी से संबंधित मानदंडों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना चाहिए, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि सभी आवेदकों के लिए निष्पक्ष, गैर-भेदभावपूर्ण चयन प्रक्रियाएँ हों।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Discriminatory and irrelevant to competence

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Questioning female job candidates about marital plans or family planning during recruitment interviews constitutes gender discrimination and violates equal opportunity employment laws.

questions.question_english: Ethical leadership requires that a Principal protects whistleblowers primarily from:
options_english: Administrative promotions to advanced leadership positions
Retaliation and adverse employment actions
Routine interactions with the Management Committee
Statutory reporting mandates under freedom of information laws
questions.explanation_english: Ethical leadership requires establishing robust protections for whistleblowers against retaliation, harassment, demotion, or unlawful employment termination. Employees who report wrongdoing in good faith risk career damage and workplace hostility. Protecting whistleblowers ensures that internal control mechanisms function effectively, encouraging transparent reporting without fear of personal or professional retribution.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नैतिक नेतृत्व के लिए व्हिसलब्लोअर्स की प्रतिशोध, उत्पीड़न, पदावनति या अवैध रोजगार समाप्ति से रक्षा के लिए मजबूत सुरक्षा स्थापित करना आवश्यक है। जो कर्मचारी अच्छे विश्वास में गलत कामों की रिपोर्ट करते हैं, उन्हें करियर को नुकसान और कार्यस्थल में दुश्मनी का सामना करना पड़ सकता है। व्हिसलब्लोअर्स की रक्षा करना सुनिश्चित करता है कि आंतरिक नियंत्रण तंत्र प्रभावी ढंग से कार्य करें, जिससे व्यक्तिगत या पेशेवर प्रतिशोध के बिना पारदर्शी रिपोर्टिंग को प्रोत्साहित किया जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Retaliation and adverse employment actions

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Ethical leadership requires establishing robust protections for whistleblowers against retaliation, harassment, demotion, or unlawful employment termination.

questions.question_english: The ethical principle of 'Veracity' fundamentally involves:
options_english: Treating all individuals with equal fairness
Refraining from causing intentional harm
Truthfulness and non-deception
Preserving professional confidentiality
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Truthfulness and non-deception'. Veracity is the fundamental ethical obligation to practice complete truthfulness, honesty, and non-deception in all communications and official documentation. In educational management, veracity requires accurate record-keeping, truthful reporting to authorities, honest communication with parents, and transparent administrative operations, rejecting misleading statements, misrepresentations, and intentional data falsification completely.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Veracity is the fundamental ethical obligation to practice complete truthfulness, honesty, and non-deception in all communications and official documentation.

questions.question_english:
A school requires the hiring of a temporary data entry
     operator. A candidate arrives for the interview
     with a recommendation letter from a high-
     ranking official. The candidate performs poorly
     in the skill test. Ethically, the Principal should:
options_english:
Appoint the candidate to honor the official’s
         hierarchy and prevent potential friction with
         departmental leaders

Appoint the candidate to the position but
         assign them simplified, non-technical clerical
         duties in the office

Reject the candidate based on skill test
         performance and document objective reasons
         for the decision

Keep the position vacant indefinitely to
         avoid taking action that might displease the
         recommending authority
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is to reject the candidate based on skill test performance and document objective reasons for the decision. Selecting staff based strictly on objective merit and demonstrated competence is essential for maintaining institutional efficiency and fairness. Yielding to political recommendation letters to hire unqualified candidates compromises operational standards and breaches recruitment integrity. Administrators must evaluate candidates using transparent, standardized benchmarks, rejecting unqualified applicants while fully documenting objective selection rationale.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। उम्मीदवार को कौशल परीक्षण के आधार पर अस्वीकार करना और निर्णय के लिए वस्तुनिष्ठ कारणों का दस्तावेजीकरण करना आवश्यक है। कर्मचारियों का चयन केवल वस्तुनिष्ठ योग्यता और प्रदर्शित क्षमता के आधार पर करना संस्थागत दक्षता और निष्पक्षता बनाए रखने के लिए आवश्यक है। राजनीतिक सिफारिश पत्रों के आधार पर अयोग्य उम्मीदवारों को नियुक्त करना संचालन मानकों से समझौता करता है और भर्ती की अखंडता को तोड़ता है। प्रशासकों को पारदर्शी, मानकीकृत मानदंडों का उपयोग करके उम्मीदवारों का मूल्यांकन करना चाहिए, अयोग्य आवेदनों को अस्वीकार करना चाहिए और पूरी तरह से वस्तुनिष्ठ चयन तर्क का दस्तावेजीकरण करना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Reject the candidate based on skill test

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Selecting staff based strictly on objective merit and demonstrated competence is essential for maintaining institutional efficiency and fairness.

questions.question_english: One of the most severe long-term consequences of persistent ethical lapses by a school Principal is:

questions.explanation_english: Persistent ethical lapses by school leaders severely damage institutional culture, destroying trust among staff, students, and parents. questions.explanation_english: The correct approach is to investigate claims discretely and review exam security before taking formal action. student discipline:

past behavior rather than shape future
behavior.

a fair opportunity to explain their side of the
incident.

questions.explanation_english:

an opportunity to explain their actions before

discipline primarily as retributive punishment
rather than educational guidance is ethically
flawed, as discipline should shape positive future
behavior.

questions.question_english: The concept of 'Zero Tolerance' in student discipline has faced ethical criticism from educational experts primarily due to:
options_english: It relies excessively on individual classroom teacher evaluation discretion
It requires institutions to allocate excessive funding to legal consultation
It applies exclusively to high-achieving academic student demographics
It ignores student context and intent, causing disproportionate penalties
questions.explanation_english: Educational experts criticize zero-tolerance disciplinary policies because they mandate rigid, severe punishments for specific infractions regardless of individual intent, mitigating circumstances, or developmental context. Automatically applying severe penalties like suspension or expulsion without flexibility violates proportional justice, disproportionately harms vulnerable students, and fails to address underlying behavioral issues constructively.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। शैक्षणिक विशेषज्ञ ज़ीरो टॉलरेंस अनुशासनात्मक नीतियों की आलोचना करते हैं क्योंकि ये विशिष्ट उल्लंघनों के लिए कठोर, गंभीर दंड अनिवार्य करती हैं, चाहे व्यक्तिगत इरादा, शमनकारी परिस्थितियाँ, या विकासात्मक संदर्भ कुछ भी हों। बिना लचीलापन के गंभीर दंड जैसे निलंबन या निष्कासन को स्वचालित रूप से लागू करना अनुपातिक न्याय का उल्लंघन करता है, कमजोर छात्रों को असमान रूप से नुकसान पहुँचाता है, और मौलिक व्यवहारिक मुद्दों को रचनात्मक रूप से संबोधित करने में विफल रहता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) It ignores student context and intent, causing disproportionate penalties

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Educational experts criticize zero-tolerance disciplinary policies because they mandate rigid, severe punishments for specific infractions regardless of individual intent, mitigating circumstances, or developmental context.
